channel.title: The Most Useful Site in the World
channel.description: 1306 free browser tools for developers, designers, students, and professionals. No sign-ups. No tracking. No ads. All offline-capable.

image.title: The Most Useful Site in the World

item.title: Eight more tools: teleprompter, word search maker, printable calendars, poster printer, photo collage, certificates, mazes and a bubble level
item.description: Eight new browser tools: a full-screen Teleprompter with mirror mode and pace matching; a Word Search Maker with difficulty levels and an answer key PDF; a Printable Calendar Maker with rule-based UK and US holidays, week numbers and personal events; a Poster and Banner Printer that tiles images or giant text across A4 pages with overlap and an assembly map; a Photo Collage Maker with sixteen layouts and print sizes; a Certificate Generator with batch PDFs from a list of names; a Maze Generator with four algorithms, SVG export and a play mode; and a Bubble Level that turns the phone into a spirit level. All run entirely in the browser.

item.title: Seven more tools: screenshot beautifier, code to image, chess clock, ASCII art, element speller, Instagram splitter and a photo booth
item.description: Seven new browser tools: a Screenshot Beautifier with gradients, frames and redaction; Code to Image with syntax colours for 16 languages and seven themes; a Chess Clock with increments, delays and byo-yomi; Image to ASCII Art with braille and colour output; a Periodic Table Word Speller that finds every element spelling of a name; an Instagram Grid and Carousel Splitter with posting order and ZIP; and a Photo Booth Strip with countdown, filters and a 2x6 inch print. All run entirely in the browser.

item.title: Six new tools: tier lists, fancy text, gamepad and monitor tests, bingo cards and a tally counter
item.description: Six new browser tools: a Tier List Maker with PNG export and share links, a Fancy Text Generator with 51 checked Unicode styles, a Gamepad Tester with stick-drift and circularity tests, a Monitor Test for refresh rate, dead pixels and motion blur, a Bingo Card Generator with UK 90-ball strips, PDF and a caller, and a Tally Counter with CSV export. Plus a fix that makes pop-ups and full-screen views in 87 existing tools cover the window again.

item.title: How mortgage payments really work — and what the bank's calculator doesn't show you
item.description: A practical, math-honest guide to how mortgage payments are calculated, what the standard formula misses, and how to think about overpayments, term changes, and total interest paid. Includes the one number the bank's calculator never shows you in the summary box.

item.title: What BMI actually measures — and why your doctor still uses it
item.description: A practical guide to what BMI is, what it isn't, why it survives as a population screening tool despite being useless for individuals, and what to use instead. Includes the three specific cases where BMI misleads, and the four better metrics in rough order of cost.

item.title: Why compound interest is magic — and why the line goes up, not straight
item.description: A practical, honest guide to how compound growth works in real portfolios and real savings. Why the line is a curve, what the 8th duplicate of your money looks like, and when compound interest works against you. Includes the rule of 72 and the one counter-intuitive result that explains why the early saver always wins.

item.title: 10 new tools added after auditing the catalogue
item.description: Ten new free browser tools covering gaps found in a full audit: Hike Time Planner, Bike Gear Calculator, Photo Exposure Lab, Race Pace Predictor, Baby Sleep Planner, Energy Tariff Comparator, Unit Price Comparator, Fluid Type Scale, Fabric Yardage Estimator, Car Care Tracker.

item.title: The catalogue just hit 1164 free tools across 23 categories
item.description: From mortgage calculators to a black-hole ray tracer, the catalogue now has 1164 self-contained browser tools. No sign-ups, no tracking, no ads. Read about the full structure on the home page.

item.title: New Help & FAQ page — answers to the 12 most-asked questions
item.description: Privacy, sharing, embedding, the Toolbox, requesting tools, troubleshooting — the things people ask most often, with honest answers.

item.title: Popular tools — 60 picks, hand-curated
item.description: Sixty of the most-used tools on the site, grouped by category: calculators, converters, developer utilities, writing, music, health, design, and a few delightful science surprises.

item.title: Embed any tool on your own site
item.description: Every tool embeddable in one iframe. No JavaScript, no API key, no sign-up. Copy the snippet and paste it anywhere.
